scope: Exact catalogue counts and local grouped metrics from the signed v1.7 public readout. Area weighted means use disjoint processing cores with at least five strictly common QSO. An area weighted mean of local P68 or medians is descriptive. To pool a counterfactual percentile and examine individual observing support and held references use private Slurm inputs. QSO counts and classes do not certify spatial zero or dark identities.
